🧠 Crypto News Brief: A Democratic sweep of Congress briefly pushed Bitcoin under $76K before a quick rebound, while fresh Binance hack revelations and a $133M theft at a French bank kept sentiment firmly in fear territory. 🗳️ Democrats Flip the Senate, Putting Crypto’s Agenda on Reset Democrats clinched a Senate majority after Josh Turek won in Iowa, reaching 51 seats with allied independents after flipping Republican-held seats in Texas, Ohio, North Carolina, South Carolina, Kansas and Iowa. The shift hands Democrats the committees that oversee digital assets, leaves the stalled CLARITY Act — which failed a 49–50 procedural vote in September — dependent on genuine cross-party support, and opens the door to closer scrutiny of Trump-linked crypto businesses. Read full story 🎢 Bitcoin Dips to $75.7K on Election Night, Then Claws Back Toward $78K Bitcoin slid to roughly $75,700 overnight as returns pointed to a Democratic sweep, then recovered to around $77,900 by Wednesday morning. The bounce comes despite persistent institutional selling: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed more than $1.15 billion across three sessions from October 30 to November 3, according to Farside data. More details 🕵️ Binance: $6.3B Heist Began With a Fake Job Interview Binance’s preliminary findings trace the record theft to months of North Korea-linked groundwork. In June, a wallet DevOps engineer installed a tampered Homebrew package while searching for an AI coding tool; in September, a second engineer ran a malicious “assignment” after two rounds of fake interviews. The exchange says it has stopped 57 suspected North Korean intrusion attempts so far in 2026. Read more 🏦 ZachXBT Names French Bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa in $133M Theft On-chain investigator ZachXBT identified French cooperative banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the suspected victim of a crypto theft he now puts above $133 million, up from the $106 million he first flagged on Monday. He said he is highly confident North Korea’s Lazarus Group is not behind the attack. The bank had reportedly applied in May for a MiCA license to offer crypto services. 81941.subject: 🌊 Democrats sweep midterms in blue wave
81941.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $78,156 (1.1%) | **ETH** $2,316 (1.6%) | **SOL** $93 (-0.3%)

* Democrats seize control of both the [House and Senate](https://x.com/WatcherGuru/status/2117830088918024582?a=KQRCS29J8Idma1ckRrw&s=20) in the midterms — Crypto’s $64M+ campaign spend fails to stop [Sherrod Brown’s Senate return](https://x.com/EleanorTerrett/status/2117921931722654124) while pro-crypto House Republicans including Steil, Nunn and Wagner [lose seats](https://x.com/solidintel_x/status/2117938797241413944?a=5Qbw63CU4H1iKqvMiLw&s=20)

* [Gold and silver prices surge](https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2117926578818810086?a=dxGzi-4rWAxHp7HJT9k&s=20) after the Democratic sweep, adding a combined $1T in market cap

* Circle posts Q3 revenue of [$865M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/circle-q3-2026-revenue-estimates-sbuyv8c) and EPS of $0.84, beating estimates

* Oracle cancels [$7B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/oracle-cancels-tencent-ai-deal-3z52dst) AI chip leasing deal with Tencent after US pressure

* AI startup Fal raises $1.3B led by Bessemer, doubling its valuation to [$16B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/ai-startup-fal-funding-wzqs2q8)

* CFTC approves first equity [perpetual futures](https://www.chooserich.live/story/cftc-equity-perpetual-futures-us-5wgddry) contracts for trading on US exchanges

* ZachXBT says the [$130M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/zachxbt-credit-mutuel-arkea-exploit-nymhrci) hack target was French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa

* Morgan Stanley becomes one of first banks to tokenize assets via [DTCC's](https://www.chooserich.live/story/dtcc-launches-tokenization-service-g5k6huc) new service

* Apple updates its insider trading policy to bar employees from using [confidential information](https://x.com/TheBlockCo/status/2117920570394505551) to trade on prediction markets

* Jack Dorsey’s Block beats estimates as it posts Q3 revenue of [$6.72B](https://x.com/gurgavin/status/2117726196792533443) — Reaches deferred prosecution deal with DOJ, settling money laundering case for [$764M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/block-doj-deferred-prosecution-deal-cyxzdww)

* Palantir posts Q3 revenue of [$2.31B](https://www.chooserich.live/story/palantir-beats-earnings-raises-guidance-sb3pp89), beats estimates, and raises full-year guidance


———

**Welcome back!** Google will make schools choose between AI and Google Search. Thousands of Lovable apps left passports and chat messages open to strangers. Your Apple Watch can now replay what people just said, and ChatGPT wants to talk about your bank account.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Apple:** What did your Apple Watch just hear?

----------
## Google bans kids from searching

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ac90191f-30aa-4e53-85c3-c6f159bd24e2/38837bdb-83a2-4d03-9255-73b265ce66f4.jpg?t=1793781379)
Caption: 

Schools that don't want AI in class are about to [lose Google Search too](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/03/us/google-search-schools-restrict-ai.html).

Starting early next year, Gemini and Google Search will be switched off for K-12 student accounts until the school's admins turn them on.

They only come as a pair. Google's head of education told The New York Times that Search and AI are now so tied together that schools can't keep one and drop the other. Kinda forcing schools that don’t want AI to keep using it, or lose the best search engine there is.

* Students at schools that keep AI off will see a message that Search is unavailable.

* Google is also testing Guided Learning in Search, which walks students through homework step by step, starting with some US schools this month.

* It only covers accounts the school manages, so homework on Mom's laptop still gets Google.

Google says schools will get the details in the coming months.


----------







----------
## This Nvidia-partner startup is quietly taking over AI distribution, and it's still early

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c8b3d705-943a-403b-85e9-f6bdd4ca8f03/Screenshot_2026-07-10_at_12.07.26_PM.png?t=1783675753)
Caption: 

Building an AI product is easy now. Getting it in front of buyers is the hard part.

Companies like Nvidia, Oracle and Notion come to us to show their products to millions. We productized that knowledge to create a market-leading GTM app called ToneUp.

Revenue grew 2.5x last year. You can invest at an early shareholder price starting from $1,000 with up to 20% bonus shares.
